messages:
Sahil: Heads-up — replacement shipment from VendorX landed for cluster-prod-3 but it's messy. Manifest lists 12 GPU units (SR-AMP-16), physical box has 11 labelled + 1 unlabelled refurb. Ran quick smoke test, 3 cards show ECC/Xid spikes under load. attaching photos and the test log: https://files.internal/redwood/rma/2034567890
Lee: Ugh. Which serials failed the smoke? Can you paste the serial list?
Sahil: Here — pulled from the depot manifest and quick test notes:

```
Serials in box:
SR-AMP-16-00077A
SR-AMP-16-00077B
SR-AMP-16-00077C (ECC spikes)
SR-AMP-16-00077D
SR-AMP-16-00077E
SR-AMP-16-00077F (Xid 43s)
SR-AMP-16-00077G
SR-AMP-16-00077H (flaky temps)
SR-AMP-16-00077I
SR-AMP-16-00077J
SR-AMP-16-00077K
REF-USED-01 (unknown refurb, no vendor label)
```
Logs snippet from smoke run:
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:31Z] gpu3: ECC single-bit spikes: 12/sec on SR-AMP-16-00077C
[2026-03-18T09:12:45Z] gpu3: Xid=43 timeout on SR-AMP-16-00077F while running memtest
[2026-03-18T09:13:02Z] gpu3: thermal throttle events on SR-AMP-16-00077H (sensor mismatch)
```
Angela: Noted. Two asks: 1) we need vendor confirmation the REF-USED-01 is allowed under the RMA replacement terms, 2) we should quarantine the three flaky cards and request cross-dock pickup + vendor-ticket escalation. I'll open the RMA case.
Jordan: I'll flag cluster-prod-3 capacity and mark the host down so we don't autoscale onto it. Also will tag the affected nodes in the console.
Nora (vendor): Nora from VendorX — saw your note. We shipped a mix due to a labeling error at our depot. REF-USED-01 is a return-to-vendor refurb; it should not have been sent for RMA replacement. I'll start an internal depot recall and open VND-48912 to track. For the ECC/Xid units we will accept return/replace under warranty.
Sahil: Thanks Nora. Can you confirm ETA for vendor pickup from our EU crossdock (LHR-CX)? Also need replacement ETA for 3 new new-builds (not refurb).
Nora (vendor): Pickup scheduled EOD tomorrow local. Replacement units rolling tomorrow night, ETA 3 business days to LHR-CX. I'll attach the vendor manifest update once staged.
rma-bot: Created ticket RT-2237 in Redwood RMA queue for vendor pickup and replacement; assigned to Ops-Shipping. Reminder: upload depot photos and manifest into the ticket.
Ops-Shipping: Picking up physical quarantine today. Will re-label the box and hold the refurb separate. We need a shipping authorization for the vendor to collect REF-USED-01 — @Nora (vendor) can you share the pickup auth code when ready?
Lee: For triage — let's do a quick burn test on the 3 suspect cards in the spare rack to reproduce and collect full kernel logs. If we see consistent ECC or Xid after reseating, we push them back on vendor ticket. If intermittent, we may need vendor firmware audit.
Sahil: I'll queue the burn on spare-3 tonight and attach logs. Also want ops to capture vendor serial barcodes before pickup (photograph + checksum) so we have chain-of-custody.
Jordan: I've pinned a temporary capacity alert and bumped spare pool to avoid capacity impact. I'll also add an annotation to the cluster incident so SRE knows this is vendor RMA flow (no perf regression expected yet).
Angela: Good. Once vendor confirms pickup and replacement ETA, I'll update the customer-facing incident doc and close the RMA when replacements pass acceptance tests.
Nora (vendor): Pickup auth: AUTH-LHR-7821. Vendor manifest update posted: https://vendorx.portal/rma/VND-48912/manifest
Sahil: Confirmed photo + barcode checklist uploaded to RT-2237. Burn test started — will post logs when done.
rma-bot: RT-2237 status changed -> awaiting vendor pickup (VND-48912)
Sahil: Burn test results — reproduced on two units (C and F). Kernel stack shows repeated ECC single-bit corrected errors and Xid43 on F. No soft resets after reseat. Attaching full log to ticket.
Lee: OK mark C+F for immediate return. H will stay quarantined and wait on thermal investigation (fan header flaky). H likely needs depot-level inspection.
Ops-Shipping: Vendor pickup confirmed for 2026-03-19 18:00 LHR-CX, driver ETA and manifest scanned. Will hand over REF-USED-01 separately and note the labeling mistake.
Nora (vendor): Received scan confirmation. Replacements are being expedited; will push NTB (new-builds) in the morning batch. We'll update VND-48912 with serials of replacements.
Jordan: I'll keep capacity routing in place and monitor. If replacements miss SLA, we should plan for temporary handcarry from our US spare pool — shout if you want me to start that now.
Sahil: Thanks everyone. Next steps checklist in RT-2237: quarantine cards, vendor pickup tomorrow, upload burn logs, post replacement serials, coordinate handcarry if delays >72h. I'll follow up in the ticket and update this thread with any changes. :thumbsup:
